notes.title: Dollhouse: Behind The Broken Mirror launches March 28 on Steam!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439674/3a1c57ddcc3b0abf55b923e6c1d8ee95acd3a57a.jpg

Hello, Horror fans!

We’re thrilled to announce that our first-person psychological horror adventure Dollhouse: Behind The Broken Mirror, will officially launch on Steam on March 28, 2025! Prepare to join  Eliza on a haunting journey through two nightmarish worlds and uncover the twisted mystery of her broken mind. 

To celebrate, we’ve just unveiled a brand-new trailer, offering a glimpse into the immersive gameplay, unsettling challenges, and bone-chilling encounters that await in this psychological horror experience.

[previewyoutube=oIaeFDudFfA;full][/previewyoutube]

Be sure to add Dollhouse: Behind The Broken Mirror to your wishlist today to stay updated on all the latest news and prepare yourself for the darkness ahead.

Wishlist NOW
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1791660/Dollhouse_Behind_the_Broken_Mirror/
